## Continuum 0.5.12

### Replied from the computer? It's gone from the phone too
- **Answer a WhatsApp (or any) message from the computer and its notification now also disappears from your phone**, not just from the computer. If the other person writes again, the new message stays and pops up as usual.

### Fixes
- **A quick answer right after your reply is no longer swallowed.** After you replied from the computer, anything from that chat was kept quiet for 20 seconds, so a fast answer from the other person never popped up. Now only the chat's echo of your own reply is kept quiet.
- **Resuming an interrupted transfer right away works every time.** A phone that retried within a moment could be told the files were "already being received" and the retry stalled.

Update both the computer and the phone to get all of this.

Google Play Protect may ask to scan the app, because it isn't from the Play Store. Tap **Scan app**, then **Install**.
